test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a work in 60, 30 and 20 days, respectively. In how many days can A complete the work if he is assisted by B and C together on every fifth day ?
solution:
**Given:**

A complete the work in 60 days

B completes the work in 30 days

C completes the work in 20 days

**Concept used:**

Work done = Efficiency × time taken

**Calculation:**

A's efficiency = 1/60

B's efficiency = 1/30

C's efficiency = 1/20

Work done in 4 days (done by A alone) = 4× 1/60 = 1/15

5th day work (done by A + B + C) = 1/60 + 1/30 + 1/20

⇒ (1 + 2 + 3)/60 = 6/60 = 1/10

Work done in 5 days

⇒ 1/15 + 1/10 = (2 + 3)/30 = 5/30 = 1/6

⇒ 1/6 unit = 5 days

⇒ 1 unit = 5 × 6 = 30 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 30 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e310b30caec937359f3fa6a4f4f45f3cab7a67a517b175e2a6a99fe5e431b4.png] 

Work done in 4 days (by A only) = 4 units

Work done on 5th day (by A + B + C together) = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 units

Total work done in 5 days = 4 + 6 = 10 units

In 5 days 10 unit work is done

1 unit work done in = 5/10 = 1/2 days

Time to complete 60 units work = 1/2 × 60 = 30 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 30 days.**
